title: rose leaves
text: rose leaves. I am doing a craft project and these leaves are a bit too large for my project, but they are very nice.  I will figure out something to do with them.  They are about 2" long.  A very pretty green - but sort of speckled and don't look like 'rose' leaves.  They are also a little serrated on the edges - not very rose like.  All in all, they will work for something - just not sure what yet!  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
